response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND '2015-02-02 09:47:08';

assumptions.assumption: Dates are stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so text comparison matches chronological order; BETWEEN is inclusive of both endpoints as requested. Accounts with NULL date_account_opened are not counted.
